nodes.text: Use Lorewalker Han’s Forgotten Depths legacy Raid Finder entry at the Seat of Knowledge.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

destination.label: Lorewalker Han at the Seat of Knowledge
destination.directions: Inside the upper Seat of Knowledge above Mogu’shan Palace. Use a supported current route to the upper building.

nodes.text: Defeat Tortos to open the cavern route. If needed, damage Whirl Turtles until they retreat into their shells, then use Kick Shell to send a shell at Tortos during Furious Stone Breath. Avoid falling rocks and the cave bats.

recovery.text: Kick an available defeated turtle shell, not a live turtle. If you cannot finish the encounter safely, use a suitable group or another activity; this guide makes no solo-readiness claim.

nodes.text: Proceed from Tortos into the connecting Forgotten Depths caverns toward Megaera. Find Gastropods on the route and kill them from range before they reach you. Loot each for Gastropod Shell.

recovery.text: Gastropods can kill at close range; do not run into them. This is trash loot, not a guaranteed Tortos drop. Use the current saved instance and surviving trash to establish opportunities; repeated queue/reset actions do not prove respawned loot.

nodes.writtenDestination: Forgotten Depths: after Tortos opens the onward route, follow the connecting caverns toward Megaera. Gastropods are the snails on this connecting route, not boss loot.

nodes.text: Use Gastropod Shell from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
